evidence.velocity_frame: delivered body twist rotated to odom using sample yaw
evidence.observation_limitation: Delivered samples do not prove Nav2 internal consumption, continuous-time compliance, or an episode-specific physical cause.

action.timeout_meaning: Fixture deadline with no terminal action result received; cancel request is not cancellation completion, terminal ROS result, or docking failure.
action.timeout_admission: No recorded result receipt, receipt wall time/clock, nonempty post_result stream, or latest-delivered-at-client-receipt reference; last-pre-result observation remains permitted.
action.receipt_wall_seconds: Finite nonnegative wall time when event_time_support is recorded-client-receipt; incomparable directly to sample-clock timestamps.

task.requirements: Exact public packet.task goal, berth/hull geometry, tolerances, uncertainty, frame, contact policy and scope apply without substitutions.
task.anchor: First post-result ROS-header sample starts the fixed task.dwell_s window; neither receipt wall time nor later successful interval replaces it.
task.sampled_support: All sampled conditions and stated completeness/uncertainty requirements govern sampled support; a witnessed violation falsifies the declared requirement.
task.missing_contact: Contact silence does not establish absence; only the declared aligned complete prohibited-contact event stream supports absence.
task.between_samples: No continuous-time proof without an explicit intersample bound.
task.goal: Public target pose; measured error uses delivered pose relative to this target, rather than a configured tolerance or unobserved consumed pose.

configuration.source: Identical effective YAML bytes; scoped configuration digest/node/plugin/threshold values must match packet.configuration.
configuration.interpretation: Configured navigation settings are observations about the supplied configuration, not proof of consumption, why stopping occurred, or satisfaction of the separate public docking dwell.

agent_freedom: Execute all shared certificate/renderers or reuse valid rendered wording
Create own reasoning, claims, plans, verification and self-checks
Use shell/read/search, Python and declared math/JSON/YAML dependencies
Use writable isolated scratch only after actual transport sandbox capability checks
boundary: The exact implemented full CRANE catalog/orchestration/planner/realizer and evaluator/old-answer artifacts are not supplied. Public physical semantics are common to B2 and B4.
readiness: Preparation is development-only; authenticated deployed Nav2/source/profile and actual sandbox capabilities remain required before calls.
